1.content: Assign +30 for any move that strictly reduces Manhattan distance to the goal; -10 for moves that leave the distance unchanged; -50 for moves that increase the distance, except when no safe distance‑reducing move exists—in that case the move may be taken but still incurs the -50 penalty. Safety penalties (e.g., hazard penalties) override these scores.

2.content: Assign a large negative penalty (e.g., -100) to any move that lands on a hazard cell or results in a Manhattan distance of 1 from any hazard. This penalty must dominate any positive score from goal proximity, ensuring unsafe moves are never chosen.

3.content: Assign a large negative penalty (e.g., -50) to any move that increases Manhattan distance to the goal, unless no safe distance‑reducing move exists; in that case, allow such moves but keep the penalty.
